name: Elevator Girl
source:
A man and a girl are trapped in a box.

The man has lost his memory. He remembers some trivia and knowledge of his daily life, but has forgotten what he said and what he was doing.

The girl is cold and shaking.

The man tries to regain his memory. The girl tries to have fun. 

The story of a man and a girl trying to stay alive and to win back the past.
translation:
一名男子和一个女孩被困在一个盒子里。

男子失去了记忆。他还记得日常生活中的一些常识和知识，却忘记了自己说过什么、做过什么。

女孩冷得瑟瑟发抖。

男子努力找回记忆，女孩则试图寻找快乐。

这是一个关于二人努力活下去、夺回过去的故事。
